verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains nothing on settlement, reconciliation, or itemized transaction and fee reports. The closest items are adjacent features: managing terminals and transactions in the Customer Area (adyen-pos-docs-3) and changing payout settings per merchant account (adyen-pos-docs-22). Neither shows a way to match daily takings against payouts with fee-level detail, so the axis applies but there is no evidence it is delivered.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can reconcile daily takings against payouts with itemized transaction and fee reports
